negative: nudity, naked figures, unclothed people, bare bodies, exposed skin on torsos; all figures must be fully clothed in period-appropriate clothing at all times

When historical accuracy requires subtle period detail (coloured facings, fine braiding, small insignia) that image models reliably render as garish or oversized, sacrifice the period detail for visual coherence; the viewer never knows the difference and the result reads cleaner
people_directive: include people where the narrative calls for them, with natural, well-formed faces and hands, period-accurate figures, anatomically correct, emotionally expressive, naturally posed
